note: The xai preset's spec (contractspec/subsets/xai) against what the openai adapter decodes; see spec_allowlist.json for the official API. Its contract fixtures are the xai@<model> directories under testdata/contracts. Its responses subset is checked elsewhere: the /v1/responses passthrough relays xAI's body (presetSpecRoots).

unmapped.reason: known gap O1: message.refusal is dropped (models.Message has no refusal field); a structured-outputs refusal reaches the client as content null with no explanation
no canonical field: the call's position, which its place in tool_calls already gives
known gap XA7: images an image-output model streams (delta.images) are dropped; models.Delta has no slot, so an image generated in a streamed chat never reaches the client
known gap O3: streamed choice logprobs are dropped (models.StreamChoice has no logprobs field), so a stream with logprobs: true carries none to the client

known gap XA5: xAI's image metadata is dropped: models.ImageData has no field for mime_type, file_output (the file xAI stored the image as: its id, name and public URL with their expiry) or storage_error, so the client cannot tell the image's format or reach the stored file

known gap XA6: xAI's image usage cost_in_usd_ticks (what xAI charged) and input_tokens_details.cached_tokens are dropped: models.ImageUsage has no field for either, so the client loses the charge and cached prompt tokens cannot be priced at the cached rate

known gap O19: models.ImageResponse has no field for the image response metadata (background, output_format, quality, size) or usage.output_tokens_details, so the client loses what the image was rendered as and image vs text output tokens cannot be priced apart
